summary: Vault 158 recovery source is merged, and PR #618 now pins the exact upgrade-only candidate and recipient-readback procedure. The live bot remains unchanged; upgrade authority and financial recovery authority remain separate holds. ckSOL PR #610 is draft and conflicting with main; its stop-and-drain procedure is the recommended interim release choice while the reserve stays off. Stability Pool and vault 51 work continue under Bram.
plainSummary: Vault 158 recovery software and its exact upgrade plan are ready, but the live bot has not been changed and recovery remains held. The Solana processing work needs its branch conflicts resolved before review; its reserve remains off. Stability Pool and vault 51 work continue under Bram.
